verdict.comment: Preference is for TOO DARN GOOD. The other main form contenders are Supreme Diamond, Dubai Time and Kesta.

comments.arcticwind: Ardad half-brother to four winners; yard's first 2yo runner of the season
comments.astrazar: Last of seven in Ascot contest having been friendless in the betting
comments.barrytheworm: Recorded a meagre RPR in Windsor event
comments.dubaitime: Showed promise in Chester contest that is working out well; had an excuse at Redcar
comments.factual: 48,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; by Sioux Nation; major stable; interesting newcomer
comments.kesta: No progress since Brighton win but looks ready for a crack at this new trip
comments.musicalsoldier: Trailed home last of 13 at Windsor despite attracting support
comments.onestar: Starman filly; yard has a decidedly low strike-rate with 2yos
comments.perfectlocation: Cable Bay half-sister to a Group-placed 2yo winner; check the betting
comments.supremediamond: Leading player on the figures and would be an apt winner (trainer sponsors this race)
comments.sweetlord: Down the field in races over 5f and 7f; needs improvement
comments.toodarngood: Showed clear promise at Bath; withdrawn from the Woodcote at Epsom on Friday; respected

races.raceComment: kesta is marginally preferred with a score of 21.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over barrytheworm. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.title: Clive Cox Racing British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (Qual') (GBB/IRE Inc) (Div II)
races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: The main form contenders are KING OF CHAOS and Sinj. All of the newcomers are attractively bred, particularly Wojtek.

comments.bigsong: Newcomer by Earthlight and from the family of a Grade 1 scorer; interesting
comments.chilliconcarneigh: Recorded a modest RPR over 5f at Salisbury but may do better upped in trip
comments.gascony: Always towards the rear in Windsor contest
comments.kingofchaos: Showed promise with third-place finish at Windsor; one of the main form contenders
comments.priestess: 11,000gns yearling; sister to two winners; heed the market signals
comments.redsnapper: Slowly away and always behind in Brighton maiden
comments.sinj: Placed in a couple of 5f events at Salisbury, latest on Saturday; leading player
comments.starlightsami: 52,000gns yearling; by Earthlight; yard's first 2yo runner of the season
comments.whiteladder: Looks held by King Of Chaos on Windsor form but seemed to need the run
comments.wojtek: £35,000 yearling; suitably bred and would be a fitting winner (trainer sponsors this race)
comments.zavateri: 35,000gns yearling; by Without Parole; great-granddam won the Arc; check the betting

races.raceComment: sinj is marginally preferred with a score of 22.2%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 1 attempts. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The suggestion is CROWN'S LADY, who drops back in trip after a good 1m run in higher-grade company last month.

comments.clasina: 0-13 now but arrives here after two good efforts over 7f; each-way claims at least
comments.crownslady: Three good runs for new stable this spring, including 8.6f AW win; in the mix again
comments.flagoflove: Soundly beaten in two recent handicaps (1m/6f) and now 0-6
comments.harswellruby: Drops in grade after perfectly respectable York run but wide draw dents her appeal
comments.highfieldsunshine: Runner-up in two maidens last month (one over C&D); open to improvement in handicaps
comments.invincibleruby: Unexposed filly who was placed in a C&D novice last month; handicap debut today
comments.jenni: Made all at Musselburgh last month; 5lb higher and has awkward draw here
comments.libertybird: 2-10 as a 2yo; off since poor run in October and still on a fairly tough mark
comments.littlekeilee: 3-39 when based in Ireland; looks interesting on her debut for James Owen
comments.misswillows: Wide-margin C&D winner in April but well beaten since; always hard to predict
comments.rapidogirl: Rather disappointing over 6f last month but remains on a workable mark and is a C&D winner
comments.starzia: In the frame in both 6f handicaps since her novice win; moves up in trip today
comments.wichahpi: Taken off her feet before keeping on over 6f here recently; this extra 1f may suit her now
comments.withoutdelay: Not beaten far on any of three appearances this year but normally knocks about in Class 6

races.raceComment: jenni is marginally preferred with a score of 55.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over withoutdelay. Won 1 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Patrick Neville saddles a couple with live chances and COSMIC SOUL is fancied to turn things round with hat-trick chasing Zephlyn.

comments.corsicancaper: Stamina looked to give out when favourite over a stiff 2m1f last time; well handicapped
comments.cosmicsoul: Closely matched with Zephlyn and is entitled to have come on for his comeback run
comments.fleurdemer: Well held on comeback 19 days ago; needs a big step forward and also has stamina to prove
comments.morandisecond: Absent since pulled up over hurdles in February and has to prove his new mark within range
comments.myharrisongeorge: Able to dictate when beating a small field latest; 4lb rise puts him on a career-high mark
comments.myboymax: Always gone well here; pleasing C&D comeback a month ago; considered off the same mark
comments.shownofear: Given his inconsistent profile it wouldn't be a shock to see him bounce back
comments.zephlyn: Chasing a C&D hat-trick upped 3lb; respected but could do without rain

races.raceComment: zephlyn is marginally preferred with a score of 63.3%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more reliable profile over myboymax. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Last week's Thirsk winner Miss Rainbow is entitled to plenty of respect, but slight preference is for the also in-form KALGANOV.

comments.birdofplay: Hasn't shown enough lately (since back over 7f) to suggest his turn is imminent; blinkers.
comments.curiousmrsfox: 0-19; sits 1lb out of the handicap & hasn't offered much over 7f (peak RPR 41) previously.
comments.dandylichious: 1-25; runner-up over C&D (40-1) in April; lost way since; others are more persuasive.
comments.desertdream: Veteran; three C&D wins; slow to find his feet this year but return to Catterick helpful.
comments.dumfries: Thirsk (7f) winner in April; below par at Wolverhampton & Leicester; needs to bounce back.
comments.evoluir: Outpaced over 6f at Redcar (fifth of ten, beaten approx 5l) latest; place chance over 7f.
comments.kalganov: Holding form well; runner-up in two of his last three, incl at Redcar (7f, gd/fm) latest.
comments.missrainbow: Thirsk winner (5f; first-time visor) last week; reappears quickly over 7f under 5lb extra.
comments.pinjarra: Ten-race maiden; no progress for introduction of cheekpieces/blinkers; drops back to 7f.
comments.selbysjoy: 13-race maiden with mostly poor form; last of ten on Ripon seasonal reappearance (125-1).

races.raceComment: desertdream is confidently preferred with a score of 52.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over evoluir. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
